digest.component_or_area: plan-review criterion T15 registration and artifact authoring
propositions: The T15 overlay-derisk criterion rubric must be authored verbatim into plan_review_T15.md with YAML front-matter including execution_mode: agentic (not 'AGENT'), dimension: overlay-derisk, and body containing applicability gates S1-S3 plus checks a-d and ANTI-FP paragraph

T15 routing entry in criteria_routing.json must specify exec: 'AGENT', facet: 'overlay-derisk', overlay_routing: 'llm', and applies_at suppress_types: ['bug'], inheriting default posture from registry
T15 must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM in registry.py and pass all validators (check_registry_coverage, validate_packaged_routing, validate_criteria_guide)
Registry regenerate-criteria-guide command must successfully output a docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md containing a ## T15 section with full rubric including the four named checks
